name: Juki
title: Juki Sewing Machines UK: Industrial and Domestic Guide
description: Juki sewing machines: the Tokyo company’s history, its industrial lockstitch and overlock machines, domestic models for home sewers, and UK parts and servicing.
intro: A leading name on production floors worldwide, with domestic machines that bring industrial know-how home.

image.alt: Large room of blue industrial machines

cardText: Industrial lockstitch and overlock machines, plus domestic models.

sections.h2: From Tokyo to the world’s factories
sections.html: Juki was founded in Tokyo in 1938 and moved into sewing machines after the Second World War, first household and then industrial machines. It became one of the best-known industrial sewing machine makers in the world.

Juki’s single-needle lockstitch machines, such as its long-running DDL series, along with overlock, coverstitch and specialist machines, are widely used in UK workrooms. Parts and needles are well supported by trade suppliers.
Juki also sells domestic machines, overlockers and straight-stitch machines for home sewers who want speed and a strong feed.

sections.h2: Parts and servicing for Juki machines
sections.html: Juki machines are among the makes PK Sewing Machines lists on its website. PKSM services and repairs domestic and industrial machines in Leicester and stocks needles, bobbins, feet and other parts. Send the model number to check a part before you buy. Leicester’s hosiery heritage means the city has deep machinery know-how.
